decisions.rationale: Commission present: average line 15000 of two NOAs = (98,495.01 + 99,928.75)/2 = 99,211.88, above stated 99,000, so no shortfall. Paystub 2026-07-22 (4 days old) annualized 3,807.69 x 26 = 98,999.94.

Cash deposit of 31,080.00 on 16/06/2026 is non-payroll, over 5,000, and no explanation document is on file (AR-06). Without it the balance (142,419) would also fall short of required 149,000 + 11,175 = 160,175.
Appraisal dated 27-Mar-2026 is 121 days old at review date 2026-07-26, over the 90-day limit (AR-04). Panel and value (750,000 vs 745,000) are fine.
Letter 2026-07-20 recent and signed. Contract since 2025-02-24 = about 17 months, in the 12 to under 24 month band (AR-11). Letter salary 96,176.40 vs stated 99,000 is 2.85% below (<=5%).
